item.title: SI recruitment scam: Another accused arrested from Bihar

item.title: Farmers stage protest over delay in opening of mandis
item.description: Jharigaon: Farmers staged a blockade in three blocks of Nabarangpur district Monday to protest delays in opening of mandis, distress sale of paddy and maize, and a sharp cut in maize prices to Rs 600 per quintal. The agitation led by the Chashi Mahasangh affected Jharigaon, Umerkote and Raighar blocks. The outfit warned that the […]

item.description: New Delhi: After more than one-and-a-half month of door-to-door Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise in Madhya Pradesh, the Election Commission of India (ECI) will release the draft electoral roll of voters for the state Tuesday. item.title: CBI expresses readiness to take over Sabarimala gold theft probe
item.description: Kochi: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has expressed its readiness to take over the probe into the alleged large-scale gold theft and irregularities at the Sabarimala temple, telling the Kerala High Court that it would have no objection to investigating the case if so directed. item.title: South Korea’s first commercial orbital rocket Hanbit-Nano crashes after liftoff
item.description: Seoul: The Hanbit-Nano, South Korea’s first commercial orbital rocket, crashed shortly afterward due to an abnormality in the vehicle, its operator Innospace said. item.title: US lawmakers condemn mob killing of Hindu man in Bangladesh
item.description: New York/Washington: US lawmakers have condemned the targeted mob killing of a Hindu man in Bangladesh, calling on authorities to protect religious minorities and restore the rule of law. item.title: Thackeray brothers formalise alliance before BMC polls
item.description: Mumbai: Ahead of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) elections, the alliance between the two Thackeray cousins, Uddhav Thackeray (Shiv Sena UBT) and Raj Thackeray (MNS) –is now official.
